data.narrative:
Tenna Systems is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Avner Bendheim and Gabriel Bendheim that has raised $13.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers (2 public, 8 private) in the same sector and adjacent funding stages, including Series A companies Stark Defence, Singularity, and NODA AI, as well as Seed-stage peer UFORCE.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $13.5M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $34M. The Peer-Median method calculates the median valuation across four directly comparable peers (Stark Defence, UFORCE, Singularity, NODA AI) at $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. This wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage and capital intensity within the Defense & Security sector.

The two methods produce materially divergent signals. Triangulated results support a valuation range of $29M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $367M. The significant gap between stage-progression and peer-median approaches reflects Tenna's early stage relative to more mature comparables. Key uncertainties include the company's current unit economics, customer traction, and whether it is closer in maturity profile to Seed peers like UFORCE or to earlier Series A entrants. Additional disclosure on revenue or customer commitments would refine this range considerably.
